# Copilot

Follow root `AGENTS.md` and the nearest subtree `AGENTS.md`; current repository/runtime state overrides stale prose.

Use existing Makefile targets instead of adding parallel task, lint, build, or test orchestration. Prefer deletion/reuse and the smallest focused diff. Fail fast rather than hiding unexpected errors with broad catches, retries, or fallback defaults.

Do not claim PASS without executed check output. Never commit secrets or private photo data.
